title: Blindsighted
description: The Nightingales pursue Mercer Frey to Irkngthand to stop him from stealing the Eyes of the Falmer and escaping Skyrim with the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal.

base_facts: I told the new Nightingale to meet Karliah and me at Irkngthand.
Mercer Frey betrayed the Thieves Guild and murdered Gallus.
We must stop Mercer before he escapes with the Skeleton Key.

JOIN_WITH_NIGHTINGALES: Karliah and I have joined the new Nightingale inside Irkngthand.
CONFRONT_MERCER: Mercer knew we were coming. He led us into a trap.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Mercer Frey is dead. The Nightingales have survived.

base_facts: Mercer Frey murdered Gallus and framed me for his crimes.
We must recover the Skeleton Key and return it to Nocturnal.
Mercer is heading to Irkngthand to steal the Eyes of the Falmer.

JOIN_WITH_NIGHTINGALES: I believe Mercer knows we are following. He may be planning an ambush.
RECOVER_KEY: The Skeleton Key must be returned to the Twilight Sepulcher.
ESCAPE_AND_REPORT: We survived. The Skeleton Key must be returned to the Twilight Sepulcher.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I gave my Nightingale Bow to our newest Nightingale. The journey to return the Key must be undertaken alone.

base_facts: I possess the Skeleton Key of Nocturnal.
I murdered Gallus and used the Guild for my own gain.
The Eyes of the Falmer will make me wealthy enough to disappear forever.

CONFRONT_MERCER: I knew you would come. Now the Nightingales will die.

beats.comment: Player travels to Irkngthand to confront Mercer Frey.
Karliah and Brynjolf join the player inside Irkngthand to pursue Mercer.
Player locates and fights Mercer Frey in the Irkngthand Sanctuary.
Mercer is slain; player retrieves the Skeleton Key as the chamber floods.
Player escapes the flooding Irkngthand and speaks with Karliah at Bronze Water Cave.
Quest completes; Karliah gives the Nightingale Bow and instructs the player to return the Skeleton Key to the Twilight Sepulcher.
